add_arcs.name: The First Bond
add_arcs.desc: A wild creature chooses to stay after the danger has passed.

add_arcs.name: Rival Tamer
add_arcs.desc: A rival bonds differently with their creatures and forces the hero to question their own methods.

add_arcs.name: Evolution Crisis
add_arcs.desc: A trusted partner changes form at the worst possible moment and no longer behaves the same way.

add_arcs.name: Sanctuary Raid
add_arcs.desc: Poachers strike a protected habitat and every captured creature becomes a tactical problem.

add_arcs.name: Tournament Circuit
add_arcs.desc: A season of sanctioned creature battles turns friendship into pressure and reputation into stakes.

add_arcs.name: Runaway Apex
add_arcs.desc: The strongest creature in the region escapes control and begins following an unknown migration instinct.

add_arcs.name: The Lineage Egg
add_arcs.desc: An inherited egg carries expectations that matter more to the adults than to the creature inside.

add_arcs.name: Set Them Free
add_arcs.desc: The final proof of a bond may be choosing not to own it anymore.

add_arcs.name: The First Score
add_arcs.desc: A small job goes perfectly and makes the crew visible to people they should never have met.

add_arcs.name: Undercover Badge
add_arcs.desc: An investigator enters the organisation deeply enough that their real loyalties become inconvenient.

add_arcs.name: Family Debt
add_arcs.desc: A debt inherited through family ties turns a private relationship into underworld business.

add_arcs.name: The Heist Blueprint
add_arcs.desc: The perfect plan depends on six specialists, one impossible window and nobody improvising.

add_arcs.name: Burned Informant
add_arcs.desc: The one person feeding both sides information is exposed before either side is ready.

add_arcs.name: Turf War
add_arcs.desc: Two organisations turn ordinary streets into a shifting map of loyalty and retaliation.

add_arcs.name: Evidence Locker
add_arcs.desc: A sealed piece of evidence disappears from police custody without any recorded entry.

add_arcs.name: Fall of the Kingpin
add_arcs.desc: Removing the person at the top leaves a vacuum more dangerous than the empire they controlled.

add_arcs.name: The First Siren
add_arcs.desc: Emergency sirens sound for the first time and nobody yet knows which direction is safe.

add_arcs.name: The Evacuation Line
add_arcs.desc: A defence plan becomes a human story as one district is ordered to leave everything behind.

add_arcs.name: Defence Force Mobilises
add_arcs.desc: Specialist crews deploy against a target whose behaviour invalidates every simulation.

add_arcs.name: The Hatchling
add_arcs.desc: A juvenile giant is found before anyone can agree whether it is a specimen, a weapon or a child.

add_arcs.name: City Breaker
add_arcs.desc: A monster crosses the final defence line and the city itself becomes the battlefield.

add_arcs.name: Monster Ecology
add_arcs.desc: Researchers discover the attacks are part of a larger ecosystem rather than isolated disasters.

add_arcs.name: The Weapon That Fails
add_arcs.desc: The celebrated anti-monster weapon works exactly once before the enemy adapts.

add_arcs.name: Final Colossus
add_arcs.desc: A creature large enough to change the map forces every surviving faction into the same battle.

add_arcs.name: The Forbidden Text
add_arcs.desc: A document contains information that changes the reader simply by being understood.

add_arcs.name: Signal in the Dream
add_arcs.desc: Different people begin dreaming the same transmission before any instrument detects it.

add_arcs.name: The Cult in Plain Sight
add_arcs.desc: The conspiracy is not hidden; everyone simply agrees not to notice what its rituals mean.

add_arcs.name: When Geometry Breaks
add_arcs.desc: A familiar building gains a corridor that cannot fit inside its own walls.

add_arcs.name: The Name That Should Not Be Spoken
add_arcs.desc: An ancient name produces the same physical reaction in every language.

add_arcs.name: The Expedition Below
add_arcs.desc: The research team descends past geology into a layer of the world that behaves like memory.

add_arcs.name: A Bargain With Sanity
add_arcs.desc: The only way to understand the threat is to surrender one certainty the hero cannot recover.

add_arcs.name: The Sky Is Wrong
add_arcs.desc: The stars rearrange themselves into a pattern that is unmistakably looking back.

add_arcs.name: Caravan Oath
add_arcs.desc: Travellers crossing hostile dunes bind themselves to an old code of hospitality and protection.

add_arcs.name: The Djinn Bargain
add_arcs.desc: A wish is granted exactly as spoken and the real negotiation begins afterward.

add_arcs.name: Palace Coup
add_arcs.desc: A royal succession turns servants, guards, merchants and relatives into temporary factions.

add_arcs.name: The Lost City
add_arcs.desc: A city swallowed by the desert is found intact, lit and apparently expecting visitors.

add_arcs.name: Duel at High Sun
add_arcs.desc: A public duel decides a private dispute while the whole city chooses sides.

add_arcs.name: The Thief of Brass
add_arcs.desc: A legendary thief steals an object whose owner has never admitted possessing it.

add_arcs.name: Voyage Beyond the Dunes
add_arcs.desc: A sea voyage becomes a desert expedition when the map proves older than the coastline.

add_arcs.name: The Masterless Lamp
add_arcs.desc: A relic offers power but recognises no owner, forcing every claimant to prove what they actually want.

add_arcs.name: Black-Market Beast
add_arcs.desc: A criminal auction sells bonded creatures to buyers who see partners as equipment.

add_arcs.name: Bond With a Colossus
add_arcs.desc: A creature too large to contain responds to one person as if it has been waiting for them.

add_arcs.name: The Unknowable Companion
add_arcs.desc: Something impossible imitates the rituals of a bonded creature without proving it understands affection.

add_arcs.name: Djinn Companion
add_arcs.desc: A spirit joins the journey under a contract that slowly becomes indistinguishable from friendship.

add_arcs.name: Kaiju Smuggling Ring
add_arcs.desc: Fragments, eggs and living specimens move through an underworld supply chain beneath the defence force.

add_arcs.name: Occult Syndicate
add_arcs.desc: An organised crime network discovers that forbidden knowledge can be trafficked like any other commodity.

add_arcs.name: The Desert Heist
add_arcs.desc: A crew crosses a guarded desert kingdom to steal from a palace vault built around an older ruin.

add_arcs.name: Star-Devourer
add_arcs.desc: A giant organism arrives from deep space and astronomers realise its route is deliberate.

add_arcs.name: The Sand Colossus
add_arcs.desc: A buried giant rises beneath a caravan city and carries architecture from a forgotten age on its back.

add_arcs.name: City Beneath the Dunes
add_arcs.desc: Ancient ruins below the desert preserve a civilisation whose gods were not metaphors.
